bugLogs.title: Insufficient text contrast on promotional banner
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the promotional banner with class "promo"
Observe the text color #d9c27a on background #ffe9a8
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background per WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.4.3.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The text contrast ratio is 1.46:1, which is below the required 4.5:1 threshold.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for div, change color from #d9c27a to #756942 (4.53:1 on #ffe9a8; measured 1.46:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Missing language attribute on <html> element
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The <html> element must have a valid lang attribute (e.g., <html lang="en">) so assistive technologies can determine the page language.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <html> element is present without a lang attribute.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a lang attribute with the appropriate BCP 47 language code to the root element, e.g., change <html> to <html lang="en">.

bugLogs.title: Missing alternative text on hero banner image
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the hero image at the top of the page
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The element must have a descriptive alt attribute or be marked as decorative with role="presentation" or alt="".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element has no alt attribute, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or role override.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute, e.g., alt="Summer sale banner promoting 30% off all items" to img[src='hero-summer-sale.jpg']

bugLogs.title: Icon-only link to cart lacks accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Press Tab to navigate through focusable elements
Observe that the cart link receives focus but no text is announced
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The link should have a discernible accessible name so screen readers announce its purpose (e.g., "View cart").
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element has no visible text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an aria-label attribute to the link:

bugLogs.title: Missing persistent label for newsletter email input
steps_to_reproduce: Scroll to the newsletter signup section
Focus on the email input field
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The email input must have a visible, persistent label that is programmatically associated with the control.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The input only has placeholder text and no <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a label element and associate it with the input: <label for="news-email">Email address</label> placed before the <input type="email" id="news-email" placeholder="Your email address">. Optionally, keep the placeholder for hinting but ensure the label remains visible.
